questions.text: Group A values are 12, 13, 14. Group B values are 19, 20, 21. How much greater is Group B’s mean?

questions.text: To compare travel times of 36 sixth graders and 41 seventh graders, which plan is best?

Measure one grade in minutes and ignore the other
Ask only one person in the whole school
Record favorite colors instead of travel times
